common.offline: No internet connection. Nothing can change until it is back.
common.idleSignedOut: For safety, you were signed out after 30 minutes without activity.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: For Click Group panel admins only.
login.noAccess: This account is not a panel admin.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

newPassword.title: Choose your own password
newPassword.description: Someone else set this password for you. Choose a new password of your own before using the panel.
newPassword.short: A password has at least {{min}} characters.
newPassword.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
newPassword.same: The new password must differ from the old one.
newPassword.weak: This password is too weak. Choose a stronger one.

twoStep.setupDescription: The panel requires two-step login. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then type the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoStep.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
twoStep.secret: Or type this key into the app:
twoStep.checkTitle: Type the code from your app
twoStep.checkDescription: Type the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows.
twoStep.wrong: The code is wrong or has expired. Type the app's new code.
twoStep.lostDevice: I lost my device: use a recovery code

recovery.useDescription: Type one of the codes you saved when you set up two-step login. The old device is removed and you set up a new app right away. Each code works only once.
recovery.showDescription: Keep these 10 codes somewhere safe, for example a password manager. If you lose your authenticator device, one of them lets you in. Each code works only once.
recovery.label: Recovery codes
recovery.copyFailed: Could not copy. Write the codes down by hand.
recovery.fileHeader: Click Group panel recovery codes ({{email}}). Each code works only once.
recovery.shownOnce: These codes are shown only now and are stored nowhere.

temporaryPassword.label: Temporary password
temporaryPassword.copyFailed: Could not copy. Write the password down by hand.
temporaryPassword.shownOnce: This password is shown only now. Give it to its owner; they choose their own at their first login.

gym.offlineNote: This is an offline gym: it follows its license, not this panel.
gym.membersNote: Archived members aren't counted. Only the numbers are shown, never the members' names or details.
gym.lastDevice: Last time a device was seen
gym.limitsNote: Lowering a limit removes nothing that exists; it only stops new ones. Empty: no limit.

suspend.title: Suspend the gym
suspend.description: The gym becomes view-only at once: its staff can log in and see their data, but they can't add or change anything.

lock.title: Lock the gym
lock.description: Only for exceptional cases, such as fraud or a stolen account. None of this gym's staff can log in, and those logged in now see nothing at once.

reactivate.title: Reactivate the gym
reactivate.description: The suspension and the lock end, and the gym works as before, unless its subscription has ended.

subscription.title: Subscription date
subscription.description: The subscription runs to the end of this day, Baghdad time. After it there are 30 days of grace, then the gym becomes view-only.
subscription.noEnd: No end (only for a demo or in-house gym)
subscription.required: Choose a date, or no end.

limits.title: Limits
limits.invalid: A limit is a whole number of at least 1, or empty.

createGym.title: New gym
createGym.codeHint: 3 to 20 lowercase Latin letters and digits, with - between them. For example: hawler-fit
createGym.codePermanent: Careful: a gym code can never change. It is part of every staff login of this gym, and it is never used again.
createGym.codeInvalid: This is not a valid gym code.
createGym.codeReserved: This code is reserved for the system.
createGym.nameRequired: The gym's Kurdish name is required.
createGym.ownerNote: The Owner gets a temporary password and chooses their own at the first login.
createGym.ownerUsernameHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and . _ - , for example: owner
createGym.usernameInvalid: This is not a valid username.
createGym.phoneInvalid: This is not a valid mobile number.
createGym.confirmDescription: A gym with this code will be created. The code can't change later.
createGym.doneDescription: Give these details to the gym's Owner.
createGym.linkHint: This link fills in the gym code by itself.

admins.title: Panel admins
admins.onlyOne: There is only one active admin. Add another, so that a lost phone never locks Click Group out of the panel.
admins.name: Name
admins.deactivateDescription: They can do nothing in the panel at once, and can't log in. You can reactivate them later.
admins.resetTwoStepDescription: For when they lost their phone. Their recovery codes stop working too, and they set up a new app at their next login.
admins.resetPasswordDescription: Their old password stops working. They get a temporary one and choose their own at their next login.
admins.addDescription: They log in with a real email address, get a temporary password, then set up their own password and two-step login.
admins.passwordShownOnce: This password is shown only now. Give it to its owner in a safe way.

account.title: My account
account.noCodes: You have no recovery codes left. Make a new set.
account.newCodesNote: The new codes replace all the old ones.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.not_platform_admin: This account is not a panel admin.
errors.invalid_gym_code: This is not a valid gym code.
errors.reserved_gym_code: This code is reserved for the system.
errors.gym_code_taken: This code is already used. Gym codes are never used again.
errors.invalid_username: This is not a valid username.
errors.email_taken: This email already has an account.
errors.cannot_change_own_admin: This can't be done to your own account; another admin does it.
errors.last_platform_admin: The last active admin can't be deactivated.
errors.wrong_code: This code is wrong or already used.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes.
errors.gym_create_failed: The gym was not created. Try again.
errors.admin_create_failed: The admin was not added. Try again.
errors.auth_update_failed: The login did not change. Try again.
errors.record_failed: The change was made but not logged. Do it again to finish it.
errors.invalid_limit: A limit is at least 1, or empty.
errors.offline_gym: An offline gym follows its license.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your internet and try again.
